findings.source_quote: “By the time he was finished with his razor (yes, he literally used a razor to cut and paste together the sections he wanted!)” and “literally take a razor to our Bibles”
findings.suggested_fix: In both places, replace «استری» with «استرا» (or «تیز دھار بلیڈ»), preserving the point that Jefferson cut the pages with a razor.
findings.translation_quote: “جب وہ اپنی استری ... سے اپنا کام مکمل کر چکا” and “اپنی بائبل پر استری نہیں چلاتا”
